facts: No snow or storms in the forecast this week; highs near 62°F at pass elevation.

avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts: No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 28.

facts.text: Snow left Mt Hood Test Site (5,380 ft) and Mud Ridge (4,070 ft) 34 to 37 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Mt Hood Test Site
evidence.detail: left May 20; earlier seasons: June 22 (2023), June 28 (2024), June 23 (2025)

evidence.name: Mud Ridge
evidence.detail: left April 19; earlier seasons: May 27 (2023), May 26 (2024), May 7 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Mt Hood Test Site (5,380 ft) and Mud Ridge (4,070 ft).

evidence.name: Mt Hood Test Site
evidence.detail: 21.7 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 62.3 in (2023), 51.5 in (2024), 57.2 in (2025)

evidence.name: Mud Ridge
evidence.detail: 6.3 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 37.0 in (2023), 27.4 in (2024), 22.8 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between March 29 and May 21, carried from the melt-out dates at Mt Hood Test Site (5,380 ft) and Mud Ridge (4,070 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Mt Hood Test Site
evidence.detail: melted out May 20, 1,223 ft above the pass; points to March 29 to May 29

evidence.name: Mud Ridge
evidence.detail: melted out April 19, 87 ft below the pass; points to March 29 to May 13
